crossRefs.note: Zedekiah the king said, “Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can’t do anything to oppose you.”
Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you;’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
crossRefs.keyword: as seemeth good and meet unto you. Heb. as it is good andright in your eyes

parallels.note: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”

translations.web: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.
translations.bsb: As for me, here I am in your hands; do to me what you think is good and right.
